operation.description: Registry lifecycle operation. Search must use dataset.search_experience_recipes.

recipeId.description: Recipe id for draft creation or metadata update during transition.

recipeVersion.description: Recipe version, for example draft, v1, or v2.

canonicalRecipeId.description: Canonical recipe family id used for governance dedupe.

businessType.description: Business problem family, for example crm_single_model_funnel or service_sla.

route.description: Preferred execution route, for example DSL_CTE, SQL, or MEMORY_GRID.

namespaceScope.description: Comma-separated namespace scope. Blank means globally discoverable.

tenantScope.description: Comma-separated tenant scope. Blank means all tenants allowed.

permissionTags.description: Comma-separated permission tags required for discovery.

ownerRole.description: Business owner role responsible for this recipe.

actorRole.description: Local/eval fallback only. Production callers should pass registry_admin through MCP context or X-Registry-Actor-Role.

idempotencyKey.description: Required idempotency key for exactly-once lifecycle mutation replay.

expectedFromActiveForDiscovery.description: Optional expected source discovery flag guard.

reason.description: Reason stored on the lifecycle event.

evidenceArtifacts.description: Evidence artifact references required by publish_validated. All five artifactType values must be present with a supported artifactUri scheme and a sha256 hash. When artifact URI policy is enabled server-side, every artifactUri must start with an allowed prefix expanded from the effective publication context. When artifact object metadata policy is enabled server-side, each artifact must provide objectVersion or objectEtag and objectMetadata values matching namespace, tenant, owner, registryKey, canonicalRecipeId, version, artifactType, and artifactHash. When resolved object metadata is required server-side, object identity and metadata returned by the configured artifact resolver are used as trusted facts; caller-declared metadata alone is not accepted. The built-in remote HTTP resolver can map internal artifact service response headers X-Foggy-Artifact-Object-Version, X-Foggy-Artifact-Object-Etag, X-Foggy-Artifact-Hash, X-Foggy-Artifact-Size, and X-Foggy-Artifact-Metadata-* into trusted artifact resolution facts. When artifact resolution is enabled server-side, the artifact content must resolve and recompute to the declared hash. When artifact signature verification is enabled, the configured server-side verifier must accept the artifact content and signature metadata; the built-in Ed25519 verifier expects sig:v1:ed25519:<keyId>:<base64url(signature)> and binds the signature to the recipe publication context and artifact metadata.

artifactId.description: Stable artifact id or external evidence id.

artifactType.description: Evidence type. publish_validated requires one valid artifact for every enum value.

artifactUri.description: URI pointing to the signed evidence artifact. Supported schemes are foggy, https, s3, and oss. The built-in local resolver handles foggy:// references when configured with an artifact root. The built-in remote HTTP resolver handles https:// references only when remote-http.enabled=true and the target host is in remote-http.allowed-hosts; internal artifact services can return X-Foggy-Artifact-* headers for trusted object facts. When artifact-uri-policy.enabled=true, the URI must also match an allowed context-bound prefix such as a tenant/owner/recipe object path.

artifactHash.description: Content hash in sha256:<64 hex digest> format. When server-side artifact resolution is required, this hash is recomputed from artifact content before publish.

artifactSignature.description: Optional signature payload for server-side artifact signature verifier. The built-in verifier uses sig:v1:ed25519:<keyId>:<base64url(signature)>.

signedBy.description: Actor or role that signed the artifact.

signedAt.description: Optional signing timestamp. Required by the built-in Ed25519 verifier.

objectVersion.description: Optional object storage version or generation identifier. Required with objectEtag alternative when artifact-object-metadata-policy.enabled=true.

objectEtag.description: Optional object storage ETag or checkpoint identifier. Required with objectVersion alternative when artifact-object-metadata-policy.enabled=true.

objectMetadata.description: Declared object metadata expected to match the server-side publication context when artifact-object-metadata-policy.enabled=true. Required keys are namespace, tenant, owner, registryKey, canonicalRecipeId, version, artifactType, and artifactHash.

governanceEvidence.description: Publish gate evidence. publish_validated requires every status to be passed and every required evidence artifact type to be present.
